plate_findings.evidence: Anteroposterior radiograph demonstrating incarcerated medial epicondyle in the elbow joint.

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Panel A is an anteroposterior radiograph of the right elbow clearly showing the incarcerated medial epicondyle, matching the target disease and vocabulary. B: Panel B is a lateral radiograph of the right elbow showing the incarceration, supporting the diagnosis of incarcerated medial epicondyle.
